notes.title: Trouble of Tabu: Patch Notes #1!
notes.content:
I've been very busy working on Trouble of Tabu and trying to market it to the speedrunners community. A lot of new features have been added and a lot has been improved.

In short, here's a list:

[list]
[*]Better controls for keyboard & mouse! You no longer have to hold the left mouse key! Now you can just toggle between sword state(s) by pressing the spacebar.
[*]Added speedrun option to the menu! Although still a work in progress, when enabled, pressing "R" will restart the game.
[*]Added Hardcore mode! That's right! You can now play hardcore mode as well! More challenges are waiting for you!
[*]Added "Leaderboard" option to the main menu.
[*]A new stylish mouse pointer!
[/list]

[i]And fixed many bugs including the one where barrels got stuck (thanks for reporting REDO)![/i]
